actions.label: Jail the player
actions.desc: Locks the streamer in a solid cell high above the spawn point for the time you set. They can walk around inside and bump into the bars, but can't get out or earn anything until it ends, then they are put back where they were. More jail gifts add more time.

actions.label: Free the player from jail
actions.desc: Lets the streamer out of jail early and puts them back where they were.

actions.label: Add money
actions.desc: Pays the streamer this many dollars straight into their balance.

actions.label: Remove money
actions.desc: Takes this many dollars out of the streamer's balance. It stops at zero.

actions.label: Money multiplier
actions.desc: Multiplies everything the streamer earns for a while. 2 doubles it, 0.05 leaves them with almost nothing.

actions.label: Launch the player
actions.desc: Throws the streamer into the air using the game's own launch effect. Needs the game's stream mode running.
